Precondition:
1. PowerDirector signed in on the test account
2. App language English
3. The Cinematic Reel Creator tutorial was dismissed before (its template page opens directly)
4. Launcher › 「Cinematic Reel Creator」 open on its template page
Action:
1. Swipe the template cards to the 「Horror Movie」 card
2. Tap 「View photo tips」 on that card
Expected Result:
Step 1: the card shows a 「View photo tips」 chip with a lightbulb icon at its top-left corner
Step 2: the photo tips sheet opens from the bottom over the dimmed template page
Step 2: the sheet reads 「For best results with the Horror Movie template, follow this advice:」 with 「Horror Movie」 in bold
Step 2: 「Recommendation」 (blue bar) lists 「People in Frame」 and 「Layered Depth」, each a picture with a ✓ badge at its bottom-right and the caption under it
Step 2: 「Avoid」 (pink bar) lists 「Flat Composition」, 「Visible Text or Logos」 and 「Extreme Close-up」, each a picture with a ⊗ badge and the caption under it (swipe the row left to read the third)
Step 2: a full-width 「Got it」 button is at the bottom
Notes: CMS › Recommendation row Horror Movie. Find the card by its name: the CMS Order differs by region (Global, JP/TW/KOR/CHS, MyEdit/PDR/PHD).
